items.source_en:
For Cade Ordo. A rebel in his youth, and a father at his best. Sam shot straight from the hip, and rarely missed his mark. If he did he meant no harm, unless they had it coming. 

In his time, Sam walked among the stars, from the ranger badge on his chest to the constellations in the sky. But he never spent too much time gazing -- he lived for his daughter Cora, whose light was so much brighter.

items.source_en:
:: JOB LOGS
____________________________________________________________
:: 145.5.09
Okay. Power back on. Test test. Hello Jinata.

:: 145.7.24
Good god. Going 45 hours a day, working through the nights, it took all the droids we had on hand a full week to get this place scrubbed properly. Military sure was in a rush to get out of here after the Clone War ended, I guess. Finally don't have to wear my breather indoors. One building down.

:: 156.23.36
Just wrapped getting the prototypes installed and run through diagnostics. Everything looks good so far. The new age of clean-kill meat production begins today. 

:: 161.08.24
I don't want to jinx it, but the prototypes are working as expected. Better, maybe? We've had multiple successful tests, able to save all the scraps we'd expected to.

I don't want to get ahead of myself here, but this may work. This colony might just change things.

____________________________________________________________
:: 145.5.09
좋아. 전원 복구 완료. 테스트 중. 안녕, 지나타.

:: 145.7.24
세상에. 하루 45시간씩 밤낮없이 일해서, 우리가 가진 모든 드로이드를 동원해 일주일 내내 닦고 쓸어야 겨우 이 장소를 청소할 수 있었다. 클론 전쟁이 끝난 뒤 제국군이 서둘러 떠나버린 탓이겠지. 드디어 실내에서 호흡기를 벗을 수 있게 됐다. 건물 하나 해결.

:: 156.23.36
